findings: 10/10 current anchor city IDs resolve to canonical city features.
Assigned countries contribute 0 map-scope city IDs and 0 full market pages.
Rosters do not reconcile: 7 full markets, 0 roll-ups, 20 network_footprint rows, 21 map-scope registry keys, 18 map-scope city IDs, and 10 unique anchor cities.
No DiDi anchor-city crosswalk artifact was found.

finance/recal/corridors-didi.json holds 38 T3 inherited corridors, but agg-didi.json has 0 rows and 0 corridors because the only scoped market key is exactly didi rather than a didi-* market key consumed by partner filtering.
growth-didi.json is dated 2026-06-07 and is null/zero; partner JSON still presents a nonzero $5,768,158 grounded floor, 16 boats, 35 sourced corridors and 341 greenfield corridors.
Partner growth provenance names growth-didi.json/agg-didi.json, but those current files cannot produce the displayed numbers.
growth-didi.json silently borrows grab-greenfield-census.json (35 sourced / 341 headline), violating own-census or labelled-global-template rules.
All 38 scoped demand records are T3 bite2/econ_sidecar_inherit, not DiDi-specific demand anchors.
Country-reference rows are missing for New Zealand, Japan, South Africa, and South Korea/Korea.
All 7 existing Latin America market pages populate the core 14 market fields audited.
None of the 7 assigned countries has a full subproposal.
All 21 market phases have empty featured_routes arrays and omit fleet_confidence.
Per-market vessel_sizing blocks are absent.
Top-level growth_case.vessel_sizing exists, but it is not repeated per subproposal.
No phase has fleet_confidence or route-bound featured routes, so range gates and phase fleet reconciliation cannot be audited per market.
Proposal and data-clean partner JSON are byte-identical, but finance identity is broken.
0 of 38 scoped finance route IDs overlap the 9 proposal featured route IDs; only 8 of 38 scoped IDs exist in current data-clean/ROUTES.json.
No DiDi sheet ID, xlsx, deck artifact, anchor crosswalk, render receipt, or partner-specific sidecar receipt was found.
The global data-clean/economics_by_route_id.json exists, but it is not a DiDi delivery/cascade receipt.
Repository evidence confirms country-list presence for Australia, New Zealand, Japan, and Egypt but does not classify direct operation versus aggregation/JV.

South Africa, Singapore, and South Korea have no current DiDi source rows in the audited repository. They must remain unconfirmed/historical-or-JV watchlist items, not be presented as direct footprint.
Current proposal framing is Latin-America-centric and contains no assigned-country status treatment.
DiDi carries all five narrative source fields and the strict narrative section reports every 30 deck-eligible partner narrative-ready.
The full repository validator exits nonzero because seven unrelated partner files fail schema; DiDi is not among them.
No DiDi deck artifact or narrative binding output was found, so deck readiness is not delivery readiness.
python3 scripts/audit_partner_copy.py partner-pitch/partners/didi.json returned PASS with 0 internal-jargon leaks.
Copy pass does not cure stale economics or missing country status.

defect_register.title: Displayed DiDi economics contradict current aggregate and growth files
defect_register.evidence: Partner displays $5.768M floor / 16 boats / 35 sourced corridors; agg is 0 and growth is null/zero.
defect_register.impact: Partner-facing TAM is stale and non-reproducible.
defect_register.next_action: Repair scoped market identity, rebuild agg/growth/frontend splice, and verify one finance spine end to end before any deck or expansion.

defect_register.title: DiDi growth file borrows Grab census
defect_register.impact: Peer census is presented as DiDi upside.
defect_register.next_action: Use a DiDi-owned census or the labelled global 3.44/4.9/6.36 template band; never a peer file.

defect_register.title: Assigned ex-China country layer is completely absent
defect_register.evidence: 0/7 assigned clusters, 0/25 cities, and 0/7 full subproposals in current DiDi footprint/map/markets.
defect_register.impact: Four repository-confirmed countries cannot render for DiDi and three unconfirmed markets risk being overstated.
defect_register.next_action: Inherit the four official-country-list markets into existing Atlas hierarchy after operating-model review; keep the other three explicitly unconfirmed.

defect_register.title: Scoped finance route roster is detached from proposal and gold routes
defect_register.evidence: 0/38 scoped IDs overlap 9 proposal featured IDs; only 8/38 scoped IDs exist in ROUTES.json.
defect_register.next_action: Re-materialize from current gold route IDs and reconcile proposal featured/wow routes before cascade.

defect_register.title: Demand provenance is inherited T3, not DiDi-specific
defect_register.next_action: Build country/city demand and fare anchors for promoted markets; hold economics until sourced.

defect_register.title: Four assigned country-reference rows are missing
defect_register.evidence: New Zealand, Japan, South Africa, and South Korea/Korea are absent.
defect_register.impact: A future cascade would silently apply Singapore costs.
defect_register.next_action: Add source-tiered rows before any assigned-country finance run.

defect_register.title: Current subproposals lack route-bound phase detail
defect_register.evidence: 21/21 phases have no featured routes and no fleet_confidence; 0/7 markets have vessel_sizing.
defect_register.impact: Existing proposal is structurally populated but below Grab/Careem phase parity.
defect_register.next_action: Bind real route IDs/node IDs, add fleet confidence and per-market vessel sizing, then reconcile phase fleets.

defect_register.title: Canonical clusters contain misclustered/quarantined routes
defect_register.evidence: New Zealand has 10 Kotor routes; Korea has 7 nonmember routes; Singapore has 2 nonmember routes and 8 quarantined routes.
defect_register.impact: Raw route counts overstate usable cluster coverage.
defect_register.next_action: Restamp/remove nonmember routes and preserve raw versus strict counts in QA.

defect_register.title: Direct versus JV/aggregation/historical status is not encoded
defect_register.evidence: Official country-list rows prove four countries only; the repo has no operating-model discriminator and no current rows for three watchlist markets.
defect_register.impact: Partner-facing copy could incorrectly claim direct footprint.
defect_register.next_action: Add evidence-tier and operating-model fields before copy or map promotion.

defect_register.title: Brief maturity is uneven
defect_register.evidence: No cluster brief for Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, or Singapore; Wellington and redsea-egypt lack city briefs; several briefs exist only in data-clean.
defect_register.impact: Subproposal authoring will be uneven and non-reproducible.
defect_register.next_action: Promote missing briefs and reconcile partner-pitch/data-clean brief surfaces.

defect_register.title: Six of seven clusters have zero canonical marquee rows
defect_register.evidence: Only Singapore has canonical marquee counts (5 wow / 6 featured).
defect_register.impact: Dense route registries do not yet translate into flagship sales narratives.
defect_register.next_action: Run canonical marquee selection after route hygiene; bind only current gold route IDs.

defect_register.title: Sheet/deck/crosswalk/render receipts are missing
defect_register.evidence: No DiDi Sheet ID/xlsx/deck/crosswalk/render receipt found.
defect_register.impact: Cannot claim proposal-complete or deck-ready delivery.
defect_register.next_action: Create deterministic artifacts only after P0/P1 data defects are cleared.

prioritized_next_sequence: 1. Freeze partner-facing DiDi economics; do not reuse the displayed $5.768M/$1.53B figures.
2. Resolve DiDi direct/JV status for the four official-country-list markets and source status for the three watchlist markets.
3. Fix route and market identity: gold route IDs -> scoped finance roster -> aggregate -> growth -> partner splice.
4. Repair New Zealand/Korea/Singapore route hygiene and add four missing country-reference rows.
5. Add sourced demand/fare anchors, then promote Australia/New Zealand/Japan/Egypt as new_display_coverage.
6. Build full subproposals, per-phase route bindings/fleet confidence/vessel sizing, then create sheet/deck/render receipts.
